answer:
**Last Republican governor of New York : George Pataki**  
He was first elected in the **1994** gubernatorial election (his term began 1995).

On the official ballot, Pataki appeared on three separate line‑ups (the names that showed on the paper ballot):

1. **Republican**  
2. **Conservative** (the New York State Conservative Party)  
3. **Tax Cut Now** (a short‑lived third‑party line that was present in the 1994 election)

These were the exact party labels that were printed on the ballot when Pataki won his first term on November 8, 1994.  

Source: 1994 New York General Election results – ballot line ups shown in the official result PDF:  
<https://results.elections.ny.gov/contest/4905>  (shows “George Pataki – Republican / Conservative / Tax Cut Now”).

**Last Republican governor of New York : George Pataki**  
He was first elected in the **1994** gubernatorial election (his term began 1995).

On the official ballot, Pataki appeared on three separate line‑ups (the names that showed on the paper ballot):

1. **Republican**  
2. **Conservative** (the New York State Conservative Party)  
3. **Tax Cut Now** (a short‑lived third‑party line that was present in the 1994 election)

These were the exact party labels that were printed on the ballot when Pataki won his first term on November 8, 1994.  

Source: 1994 New York General Election results – ballot line ups shown in the official result PDF:  
<https://results.elections.ny.gov/contest/4905>  (shows “George Pataki – Republican / Conservative / Tax Cut Now”).
